summary: A cross-Alpine north pressure gradient dominates the week. Monday brings strong, gusty ENE wind and Tuesday a strong north wind aloft (43–50 km/h at 700 hPa): both well beyond the wind limits. Wednesday to Friday are sunny with light low-level wind but north flow aloft and a moderate (Wed), none (Thu) and weak (Fri) foehn gradient, with weak thermals; all marginal. Today was grey with low cloud. The outlook from 17 Oct stays uncertain, with recurring north-flow chances.

days.headline: Grey, mostly overcast day with weak thermals, low cloud near the ridge and gusts near 30 km/h on the plain.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −2.2 hPa (ECMWF) / −2.4 hPa (ICON) mean, peaks −3.1/−3.6; Zurich−Lugano +4.1/+4.5. Class moderate on the index, but no north flow or dry air at Bassano (W at 700 hPa, moist): no lee signature.
days.text: Light S–SE flow at launch height (8–12 km/h) and 850 hPa (8–12 km/h from S), with W 27–30 km/h at 700 hPa (~3000 m). Low cloud 70–90 % all day, modelled cloud base about 1150–1450 m, so the upper take-offs may be in cloud. Thermals weak (w* up to ~1.5 m/s around 13:00). Plain gusts 25–32 km/h from midday. Models disagree on the low-level direction in the morning. A little rain is modelled from about 17:00. The cross-Alpine pressure gradient caps the day at marginal.
days.main_risk: Low cloud on the ridge and gusty low-level wind; light rain possible late afternoon.

days.headline: Strong ENE wind at launch height (30–35 km/h) with plain gusts over 50 km/h; N wind building at 700 hPa in the afternoon.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −3.2 hPa (ECMWF) / −4.4 hPa (ICON) mean, peaks −3.5/−4.6; Zurich−Lugano +3.4/+4.8 (to +6.2). Moderate north foehn with north flow at 850/700 hPa over Bassano; air not dry (RH ~80 %), so no full lee signature.
days.text: Morning ENE flow of 30–35 km/h at launch height and 27–32 km/h at 850 hPa, with plain gusts of 43–54 km/h until early afternoon. It eases after 14:00, but the 700 hPa wind turns NNW–N and strengthens to 38–42 km/h by late afternoon, putting the south face in the lee of the massif. Partly cloudy, dry, cloud base around 1400–1600 m. Models agree on the strong morning wind. The foehn gradient and the wind are each beyond the limits.
days.main_risk: Strong, gusty ENE wind in the morning, then north wind aloft and lee turbulence on the south face.

days.headline: Strong north wind at 700 hPa (43–50 km/h) all day; south take-offs in the lee of the massif.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −0.9 hPa (ECMWF) / −2.3 hPa (ICON) mean, peaks −2.0/−3.1; Zurich−Lugano +1.4/+2.5. The models disagree on strength; north flow aloft at Bassano, air not dry (RH 75–87 %).
days.text: North wind of 43–50 km/h at 700 hPa (~3000 m) through the whole window, while launch height shows only a light SW breeze (5–9 km/h) and 850 hPa is a light W–WNW 9–11 km/h. A calm launch under a strong north flow is the classic lee setup: rotor, sudden gusts and a stalling breeze. Plain gusts 30–35 km/h in the afternoon. Mostly sunny in the morning, more cloud later; cloud base ~1400–1550 m. ECMWF and ICON disagree on the foehn gradient.
days.main_risk: Lee turbulence and rotor under the strong north flow aloft.

days.headline: Sunny with light low-level wind, but N 22–29 km/h at 700 hPa and a moderate foehn gradient keep the lee in play.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −3.1 hPa (ECMWF and ICON mean), peaks −3.7/−3.6; Zurich−Lugano +1.2/+2.0. Moderate north foehn; north flow aloft at Bassano, RH ~52–60 % (not below 40 %), so no full lee signature.
days.text: Clear sky all day. Light and variable wind at launch height (2–5 km/h) and at 850 hPa (2–10 km/h, N in the morning turning W later). At 700 hPa the north wind is 28–29 km/h early, easing to 18–23 km/h from midday. Thermals weak (w* ~1.1–1.2 m/s), modelled cloud base / thermal top ~1200–1250 m. Plain gusts 15–23 km/h. Models disagree strongly on the low-level direction. The moderate foehn gradient caps the day at marginal; the north flow aloft can still produce lee turbulence on the south face.
days.main_risk: North flow aloft with a moderate foehn gradient: possible lee turbulence despite light launch wind.

days.headline: Sunny and light near the ground; NNW 21–25 km/h at 700 hPa, no foehn gradient.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −1.3 hPa (ECMWF) / −0.8 hPa (ICON) mean, peaks −1.5; Zurich−Lugano +1.0/+0.3. No foehn gradient; weak NNW flow aloft, air not dry.
days.text: Mostly clear to some high cloud. Very light wind at launch height (1–3 km/h) and at 850 hPa (5–8 km/h from WNW–NW). At 700 hPa a NNW wind of 21–25 km/h, a north component in the marginal range. Thermals weak to moderate (w* up to ~1.4 m/s from 13:00), modelled thermal top ~1300–1400 m. Plain gusts below 20 km/h. Models agree on light wind but not on its direction near the ground.
days.main_risk: North component aloft (~22 km/h at 700 hPa) can still give some lee turbulence on the south face.

days.headline: Light E–ESE wind at launch, N flow aloft easing to ~10 km/h; models disagree on wind speed.
days.foehn_text: Bozen−Innsbruck −2.6 hPa (ECMWF) / −2.5 hPa (ICON) mean, peaks −2.7/−2.9; Zurich−Lugano +2.2/+3.1. Weak north foehn gradient; north flow aloft only in the morning, air not dry.
days.text: Light E–ESE wind at launch height (2–6 km/h) and 850 hPa from NE–E then N at 4–9 km/h. The 700 hPa NNE wind eases from 19 km/h at 09:00 to about 10 km/h from midday. Mostly sunny with some cloud later. Thermals weak (w* ~1.0–1.1 m/s from 13:00); modelled cloud base high in the morning (~1800 m) falling to ~1200–1300 m. Plain gusts below 18 km/h. Models differ by 9–16 km/h in speed through the window, which caps the day at marginal. The E–ESE flow suits the east-facing take-offs.
days.main_risk: Model disagreement on wind speed and a weak foehn gradient.

outlook.text: Ensemble median foehn gradient −3.2 hPa (range −6.2 to −0.7), north flow aloft in 37 % of members. Light wind at 850 hPa (median 6 km/h). Rain chance 18 %.
Bozen−Innsbruck median −3.0 hPa (−6.5 to +1.1), north flow in 41 % of members. 850 hPa wind median 10 km/h, 700 hPa 17 km/h. Rain chance 32 %.
North flow aloft in half of the members; 700 hPa wind median 28 km/h (up to 48). Bozen−Innsbruck median −2.4 hPa (−5.5 to +1.1). Rain chance 22 %.
Bozen−Innsbruck median −1.4 hPa (−5.9 to +1.9), north flow in 44 % of members. 700 hPa wind median 24 km/h but a wide spread (up to 55). Rain chance 13 %.
Median wind moderate (850 hPa 11 km/h, 700 hPa 30 km/h) with a wide spread up to 40/53 km/h. Foehn median −1.2 hPa, north flow in 37 % of members. Rain chance 29 %.
Bozen−Innsbruck median −0.4 hPa (−6.3 to +2.0), north flow in 35 % of members. 700 hPa median 26 km/h, spread up to 52. Rain chance 18 %.
Foehn median −0.7 hPa (−5.1 to +2.2), north flow in 32 % of members. 850 hPa median 11 km/h, 700 hPa 24 km/h. Rain chance 24 %.
Easterly low-level flow in the median; north flow in only 19 % of members, foehn median +0.5 hPa. 700 hPa median 24 km/h. Rain chance 24 %.
